## 📝 Contribute

We invite you to contribute and help improve the wiki! 💙

Here are a few ways you can get involved:

📌 Legend

⌞🟢⌝ = Small list (<20 links)
⌞🟡⌝ = Medium list (20-50 links)
⌞🟠⌝ = Big list (50-100 links)
⌞🔴⌝ = Huge list (100+ links)
⌞⚪⌝ = Resource list (300+ links, not intended to be fully cleared but rather to be used as a resource for finding new sites)
